\textbf{Limits of functions }\emph{Evaluate the following limits.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item ${\displaystyle \lim_{(x,y)\rightarrow(1,-3)}(3x+4y-2)}$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Limits at boundary points }\emph{Evaluate the following limits.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item ${\displaystyle \lim_{(x,y)\rightarrow(2,2)}\frac{y^{2}-4}{xy-2x}}$\vfill
\item ${\displaystyle \lim_{(x,y)\rightarrow(4,5)}\frac{\sqrt{x+y}-3}{x+y-9}}$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Nonexistence of limits }\emph{Use the Two path test to prove
that the following limits do not exist.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item ${\displaystyle \lim_{(x,y)\rightarrow(0,0)}}\frac{x+2y}{x-2y}$\vfill
\item ${\displaystyle \lim_{(x,y)\rightarrow(0,0)}\frac{4xy}{3x^{2}+y^{2}}}$\vfill
\item ${\displaystyle \lim_{(x,y)\rightarrow(0,0)}\frac{y}{\sqrt{x^{2}-y^{2}}}}$\vfill
\end{enumerate}
